sentences.text:
The offences alleged against the petitioner and other accused persons are under Sections 498A and 354 of the IPC.
2.

The prosecution case is that the 1st accused, being the husband of the defacto complainant along with other accused persons, who are his relatives subjected the defacto complainant to cruelty both physically and mentally on the ground of dowry.
It is also alleged that the 2nd accused outraged the modesty of the defacto complainant.

3. According the learned counsel for the petitioners, there are no specific allegations of cruelty and as such according to the learned counsel the proceedings against the petitioners are liable to be Shyamala Satheesan vs State Of Kerala on 23 February, 2026 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/113458208/
2 quashed.

entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: 4. The petition was opposed by the learned Public Prosecutor.
Though notice was served on the 3 rd respondent/ defacto complainant, she did not turn up.
6. On a perusal of the Annexure A2 complainant, it can be seen that several allegations are raised in general against all the accused persons.
However, specific allegations are made only against accused persons 1 and 2 and as against the petitioners herein, there is no serious allegations with material particulars like date.
Though an offence under Section 354 of the IPC is alleged, it is raised only against the 2 nd accused.
In the absence of any specific allegations with material particulars like date against the petitioners, no useful purpose will be served in continuing the proceedings against them.
Therefore, this Crl.M.C. is liable to be allowed.
In the result, this Crl.M.C. is allowed.

All further proceedings against the petitioner in C.C. No. 125 of 2023 on the file of the Judicial First Class Magistrate Court-II (Mobile), Kottayam arising out of Crime No. 1721 of 2022 of Gandhi Nagar police station, is quashed.
